sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: IN MID-UPPER LEVELS...RIDGING WILL CONTINUE TO COVER SRN PLAINS. IN NRN STREAM...STG SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER NRN ROCKIES AND SRN AB. THAT TROUGH WILL MOVE SSEWD ACROSS NRN PLAINS...REACHING SRN MB...CENTRAL/SWRN ND...AND CENTRAL/NERN WY BY 4/12Z. FARTHER SE...VORTICITY FIELDS ASSOCIATED WITH EXISTING/ELONGATED AREA OF WEAK TROUGHING OVER ATLC COAST SHOULD WEAKEN ESSENTIALLY IN PLACE THROUGH PERIOD. MEAN TROUGHING OVER SERN CONUS WILL BE MAINTAINED...HOWEVER...AS SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED MCV NOW OVER LOWER OH VALLEY MOVE SEWD TOWARD ERN TN. ELONGATED BANNER OF 500-MB VORTICITY SHOULD EXTEND SWWD FROM TN FEATURE TO MOB-PNS AREA THROUGH MUCH OF PERIOD AFTER ABOUT 3/18Z. AT SFC...COLD FRONT SHOULD BECOME BETTER-DEFINED AHEAD OF NRN-STREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGH..WHILE MOVING SEWD ACROSS NRN PLAINS AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS. BY 4/00Z...FRONT SHOULD REACH FROM SFC LOW INVOF NERN SD...SWWD ACROSS S-CENTRAL SD AND NEB PANHANDLE. BY THEN...SFC TROUGH WILL EXTEND FROM LOW NWD OVER ND/MN BORDER AREA...WITH WARM FRONT SEWD ACROSS IA TO STL-MVN AREA. SEPARATE/WEAKER BAROCLINIC ZONE AND TROUGH...DEMARCATING NRN RIM OF EXTREMELY HOT/WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY-LAYER AI

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST TO NEB
sections.text: SCATTERED TO LOCALLY NUMEROUS TSTMS ARE FCST TO DEVELOP DURING AFTERNOON...AS STRENGTHENING COLD FRONT...SFC LOW...INVERTED TROUGH AND RELATED CONVERGENCE MAXIMA IMPINGE UPON FAVORABLY MOIST AND DIABATICALLY HEATED BOUNDARY LAYER. DAMAGING HAIL...STG-SVR GUSTS AND A TORNADO OR TWO ARE POSSIBLE. ASSORTED MEASURES OF VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE STRENGTHENING WITH TIME DURING AFTERNOON...ESPECIALLY INVOF LOW...WARM FRONT AND TROUGH WHERE RELATIVELY BACKED SFC WINDS CONTRIBUTE TO ENLARGED 0-1 AND 0-3 KM AGL HODOGRAPHS. FCST WIND PROFILES YIELD 40-50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES FROM SERN SD NWD THROUGH CYCLONE PAST GFK AREA AND EWD OVER ADJOINING PORTIONS WRN MN...WHERE LOW-LEVEL SRH ALSO MAY BE MAXIMIZED. LCL HEIGHTS WILL BE ON HIGH END OF SPECTRUM BUT TORNADOES STILL MAY OCCUR WITH A SUPERCELL OR TWO IN REGIME NEAR LOW AND TROUGH. MODIFIED MODEL SOUNDINGS SUGGEST MLCAPE 1500-3000 J/KG IS POSSIBLE...AIDED BY STEEP LOW-MIDDLE LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MID-60S F. CLUSTER OF TSTMS MAY PERSIST FROM AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING ACTIVITY AND MOVE EWD OVER PORTIONS WRN/CENTRAL MN...WITH RISK FOR DAMAGING GUSTS AND OCNL HAIL. DEEPER MIXING AND HIGHER LCL ARE FCST SWD ACROSS SERN SD INTO NEB...ALONG WITH G

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: WIDELY SCATTERED...HIGH-BASED TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP FROM CATEGORICAL SVR AREA SWD ACROSS CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS AND EWD INVOF SRN TROUGH/BAROCLINIC ZONE. VERY DEEP/WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYERS SUGGEST POTENTIAL FOR ANY STG-SVR GUSTS AND ISOLATED HAIL TO REACH SFC. WEAK DEEP-LAYER WINDS WILL LIMIT OVERALL ORGANIZATION...MAGNITUDE AND LONGEVITY OF THIS THREAT...WHICH SHOULD FALL WITHIN 3/21Z-4/03Z TIME FRAME.

sections.title: NRN MID-ATLC AND NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: AS WEAKENING MID-UPPER LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH CROSSES SERN QUE...TRAILING COLD FRONT SHOULD MOVE SLOWLY SWD OVER PORTIONS NRN/ERN NY AND NEW ENGLAND. WIDELY SCATTERED TO SCATTERED TSTMS ARE FCST TO DEVELOP INVOF THIS FRONT...WITH INITIALLY SEPARATE AREA OF CONVECTION POSSIBLE IN MORE MOIST/STRONGLY HEATED BOUNDARY LAYER FARTHER S OVER SERN NY AND SRN NEW ENGLAND. LOW-LEVEL WINDS SHOULD BE WEAK OVER THIS AREA...WITH PRIMARY WLY COMPONENT AND NEARLY UNIDIRECTIONAL DEEP-LAYER WIND PROFILES LIMITING BOTH LOW-LEVEL SHEAR AND CONVERGENCE. HOWEVER...SFC DEW POINTS GENERALLY 60S F WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE 1000-2000 J/KG. THIS AREA ALSO WILL BE WITHIN SRN RIM OF STRONG UPPER-LEVEL WINDS...POTENTIALLY AIDING IN MULTICELLULAR TSTM ORGANIZATION. SVR RISK SHOULD DIMINISH CONSIDERABLY AFTER 4/00Z.

sections.title: SERN CONUS
sections.text: SCATTERED TO NUMEROUS TSTMS IN CLUSTERS SHOULD DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON...OFFERING THREAT FOR STG TO DAMAGING GUSTS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL. PRECONVECTIVE AIR MASS OVER MUCH OF THIS REGION WILL BE CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEW POINTS MID-60S TO LOW 70S F...AND STG SFC HEATING YIELDING FAVORABLE SUBCLOUD PROFILES FOR STG/ISOLATED SVR DOWNDRAFTS. DEEP-LAYER WINDS AND SHEAR WILL BE WEAK...LEAVING COLD POOLS AND MESOSCALE BOUNDARIES AS PRIMARY AREAS FOR BEST-ORGANIZED MULTICELLULAR CONVECTION TO DEVELOP. MAIN CONVECTIVE CONCENTRATIONS ARE LIKELY OVER CAROLINAS AND INVOF SHORTWAVE TROUGH/MCV...AND SOME PART OF THIS AREA MAY REQUIRE CATEGORICAL-THRESHOLD WIND PROBABILITIES ONCE LOW-LEVEL/MESOSCALE FOCI BECOME BETTER DEFINED. ..EDWARDS/GARNER.. 08/03/2012

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PARTS OF MS AND AL
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS AN UPPER LOW/VORTICITY MAX BECOMING ELONGATED WITH A NE/SW AXIS AS IT MOVES SEWD ACROSS SRN ALBERTA TOWARD MT. THIS SYSTEM IS FORECAST TO TURN MORE EWD AS IT MOVES ACROSS THE NRN MT REGION TODAY...MAINTAINING A POSITIVE TILT AS IT CONTINUES EWD ALONG THE NRN ND BORDER TONIGHT. A BAND STRONG WESTERLY FLOW ALOFT ALONG THE SRN PERIPHERY OF THE SYSTEM WILL SPREAD EWD ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS AND STRENGTHEN THROUGH TONIGHT. AT THE SURFACE,,,A COLD FRONT WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS THE DAKOTAS TODAY APPROACHING THE RED RIVER VALLEY BY EVENING...AND PROGRESS TO A ERN MN/WRN IA/NWRN KS LINE BY LATER TONIGHT. THE FRONT WILL PROVIDE A PRIMARY FOCUS FOR STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. FARTHER SOUTH IN THE PLAINS AND MS VALLEY...A SECOND FRONT WILL EXTEND FROM A THERMAL LOW OVER WRN OK/TX PANHANDLE ENEWD ACROSS NRN OK AND EXTREME SRN MO INTO THE LOWER TN VALLEY. THIS WILL BE REINFORCED BY OCCASIONAL THUNDERSTORMS OCCURRING ALONG/NORTH OF THE BOUNDARY.

sections.title: ERN DAKOTAS/MN SWWD INTO CENTRAL NEB
sections.text: SEVERAL ELEVATED CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS ARE CONTINUING OVER PARTS OF NWRN MN AND SERN SD/NERN NEB IN RESPONSE TO ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A WEAK SHORT WAVE TROUGH AND LOW LEVEL WARM ADVECTION OVER THE AREA. THE MN STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO PROGRESS EWD WITH DIMINISHING CLOUDS AND STRONG DIABATIC HEATING EXPECTED OVER ND IN ADVANCE OF THE AFOREMENTIONED COLD FRONT. FARTHER SOUTH...THE CONVECTION OVER SD AND NERN NEB IS WEAKENING BUT ASSOCIATED CLOUDS MAY PERSIST THIS MORNING AND POSSIBLY INHIBIT THE ONSET OF STRONGER DESTABILIZATION ACROSS PARTS OF THE AREA. THERE WILL BE AN INCREASE IN LOW LEVEL MOISTURE /SURFACE DEW POINTS REACHING THE MID-UPPER 60S/ AHEAD OF THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT WHERE SOUTHERLY WINDS WILL STRENGTHEN IN RESPONSE TO FALLING PRESSURES AHEAD OF THE UPPER TROUGH. THE COMBINATION OF INCREASING LOW LEVEL MOISTURE...STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND AREAS OF DIABATIC HEATING WILL RESULT IN AN AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE OF 1500-2000 J/KG. THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON NEAR THE COLD FRONT AS IT PROGRESSES EWD/SEWD ACROSS THE DAKOTAS. WINDS ARE FORECAST TO VEER AND INCREASE WITH HEIGHT WITH SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR /35-45 KT IN THE LOWEST 6

sections.title: MS/AL
sections.text: SEVERAL CLUSTERS OF STRONGER CONVECTION HAVE DEVELOPED FROM EAST CENTRAL AR INTO WRN TN WITHIN AN UPPER LEVEL DIFLUENT ZONE ALONG THE SRN EDGE OF STRONGER WESTERLY HIGH LEVEL WINDS. 12Z SOUNDINGS AT JAN AND BMX CONTAIN A LAYER OF STEEPER LAPSE RATES BETWEEN 850-500 MB...AND WITH AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE /LOWEST 100 MB MIXING RATIOS NEAR 18 G PER KG/...THE AIR MASS IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE THIS AFTERNOON WITH MLCAPE OF 2500-4000 J/KG. ALTHOUGH WINDS ALOFT ARE CURRENTLY WEAK...STRONGER NNWLY MID LEVEL WINDS ARE FORECAST TO INCREASE /ESPECIALLY OVER MS/ WITH SOME POTENTIAL FOR ORGANIZED MULTICELL STORMS TO DEVELOP. THE PRESENCE OF DRY AIR ABOVE THE PBL AND STEEPENING LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL ENHANCE POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WET MICROBURSTS TO OCCUR THROUGH THE AFTERNOON HOURS...ALONG WITH LOCALIZED HAIL.

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS INTO THE MIDDLE MS VALLEY/LOWER TN VALLEY
sections.text: WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUE ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL/ERN KS IN ASSOCIATION WITH AN EWD MOVING MCV. ADDITIONAL STORMS HAVEN BEEN OCCURRING DOWNSTREAM INTO PARTS OF AR AND THE MID SOUTH ALONG THE ERN EDGE OF A PLUME OF STEEPER MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES EXTENDING FROM THE PLAINS TO THE MS VALLEY. 20-25 KT MID LEVEL WINDS WILL PROVIDE SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR A FEW MULTICELL CLUSTERS TO DEVELOP WITH POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. ..NRN MID-ATLANTIC STATES AND NEW ENGLAND... RADAR INDICATES SCATTERED WEAK CONVECTION ALONG A COLD FRONT MOVING SEWD ACROSS NY. ADDITIONAL CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP INTO PARTS OF NEW ENGLAND ALONG/SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY WHERE BREAKS IN CLOUDS WILL ALLOW STRONGER HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION TO OCCUR. A FEW STRONG/MARGINALLY SEVERE STORMS MAY BE POSSIBLE BUT OVERALL THREAT WILL BE LIMITED BY WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR. ..WEISS/SMITH.. 08/03/2012

sections.title: NRN PLAINS/MN AREA THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: A WELL-DEFINED SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS MOVING ESEWD OVER CENTRAL/ERN MT THIS MORNING...WITH A PRONOUNCED BELT OF ASCENT PRECEDING THE TROUGH. AN ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT WILL PROGRESS EWD ACROSS THE DAKOTAS TO WRN MN OVERNIGHT...AND SEWD ACROSS THE NRN AND CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS BY 04/12Z. THIS FRONT WILL ACT AS THE PRIMARY FOCUS FOR THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT LATER THIS AFTERNOON...AS SURFACE HEATING WEAKENS CONVECTIVE INHIBITION...AND THE BELT OF ASCENT BEGINS TO PHASE WITH THE SURFACE FRONT. REGIONAL 12Z SOUNDINGS REVEALED 7.5-9 C/KM MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES OVER THE NRN PLAINS...WHERE SURFACE TEMPERATURES NEAR 90 F WILL LARGELY ELIMINATE THE CAP FROM BELOW...AND BOOST MLCAPE TO THE 2000-2500 J/KG RANGE. ELEVATED CONVECTION WILL LIKELY FORM SOONER ACROSS CENTRAL ND...WITH THE MORE CLEARLY SURFACE-BASED STORMS FORMING 19-21Z AS A RESULT OF HEATING/MIXING...IN COMBINATION WITH BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S AND THE ARRIVAL OF THE MIDLEVEL ASCENT. STORMS WILL THEN SPREAD EWD/SEWD THROUGH THE EVENING/OVERNIGHT HOURS. MEANWHILE...DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BECOME FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS BY MID AFTERNOON WITHIN THE FIRST FEW HOURS AFTER INITIAL STORM DEVELOPMENT...WHEN THE LARGEST HAIL AND

sections.title: MS/AL THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: REMNANT OVERNIGHT CONVECTION PERSISTS AS OF MID MORNING OVER NRN MS...IN ADVANCE OF A WEAK MIDLEVEL TROUGH MOVING SEWD OVER TN. STRONG SURFACE HEATING AND RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE TO THE S OF THE ONGOING STORMS WILL RESULT IN MLCAPE VALUES INCREASING TO 3000-4000 J/KG...AND CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WILL BE LARGELY REMOVED ONCE SURFACE TEMPERATURES REACH 90 F. STRONG INSTABILITY...THE ERN EXTENT OF THE STEEP LAPSE RATE PLUME FROM THE SRN PLAINS...AND 25-30 KT MIDLEVEL NWLY FLOW SAMPLED BY THE VWP/S AT NQA AND GWX...WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS WITH THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL.

sections.title: SE KS TO MO/SRN IL/WRN KY THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: AN MCV OVER ERN KS WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE GENERALLY EWD ACROSS MO THIS AFTERNOON...INVOF A DIFFUSE REMNANT FRONTAL SEGMENT. SURFACE HEATING IN THE WAKE OF MORNING CONVECTION AND IN ADVANCE OF THE MCV CLOUD SHIELD...ESPECIALLY ACROSS SE MO/SRN IL...COULD SUPPORT ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON. CONFIDENCE IS SOMEWHAT LOW IN DETAILS OF HOW/WHEN ADDITIONAL STORMS WILL FORM...SO WILL OPT TO MAINTAIN LOW WIND/HAIL PROBABILITIES.

sections.title: INTERIOR NY/NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: A SURFACE COLD FRONT WILL CROSS THE SAINT LAWRENCE VALLEY AND MOVE INTO NRN NY/NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTERNOON...WITH MODEST MOISTURE/INSTABILITY EXPECTED S OF THE FRONT AS TEMPERATURES WARM INTO THE 80S. AN ASSOCIATED LOW-AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND BELT OF STRONGER FLOW WILL REMAIN N OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER...THUS VERTICAL SHEAR AND FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL REMAIN RATHER WEAK ACROSS NY/NEW ENGLAND. STILL...DAYTIME HEATING AND WEAK ASCENT ALONG THE FRONT...AS WELL AS LOCAL TERRAIN INFLUENCES...SHOULD SUPPORT ISOLATED-WIDELY SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON. THE STRONGEST STORMS COULD PRODUCE STRONG DOWNBURST WINDS AND MAINLY SUB-SEVERE HAIL...PRIOR TO STABILIZATION OF THE BOUNDARY LAYER THIS EVENING. ..THOMPSON/MOSIER.. 08/03/2012

sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER CNTRL MS AND AL...

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: NO CHANGES TO THE NRN PLAINS SLIGHT RISK. STORMS ARE BEGINNING TO INCREASE ACROSS CNTRL ND INTO N CNTRL SD...AND SHOULD CONTINUE TO EXPAND AND STRENGTHEN. ISOLATED VERY LARGE HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE WHILE STORMS ARE CELLULAR...WITH A DAMAGING WIND THREAT INCREASING LATER TODAY. FOR MORE INFORMATION SEE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1691.

sections.text: EXPANDED LOW SEVERE PROBS ACROSS THE AREA WITH SEVERAL SMALL BUT INTENSE CORES NOTED ON RADAR. SPORADIC STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MAY PERSIST FOR SEVERAL HOURS NEAR A DIFFUSE BOUNDARY AS HIGHER THETA-E AIR GRADUALLY SHIFTS NWD.

sections.text: A VERY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS REMAINS OVER THE REGION WITH PWAT AROUND 2.25". A SMALL CLUSTER OF STORMS CURRENTLY EXISTS OVER W CNTRL AL...WHERE LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS MAY OCCUR. OTHER STORMS WERE FORMING ACROSS SRN LA/MS/AL...AND MAY HAVE SOME PROPAGATION COMPONENT TO THE N. THUS...ADDITIONAL ACTIVITY CANNOT BE RULED OUT ACROSS CNTRL MS. ..JEWELL.. 08/03/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT FRI AUG 03 2012/

LATTER PERTURBATION IS FCST TO TURN EWD..MAINTAINING POSITIVE TILT...AND REACH SERN MB...S-CENTRAL ND AND BLACK HILLS REGION BY 12Z. RELATED SFC CYCLONE -- ANALYZED AT 23Z JUST N OF MN/MB BORDER -- WILL DEEPEN CONSIDERABLY OVERNIGHT AS UPPER TROUGH APCHS...REACHING NWRN ONT BY END OF PERIOD. TRAILING SFC COLD FRONT -- ANALYZED FROM LOW SWWD ACROSS SERN ND...S-CENTRAL SD AND NEB PANHANDLE...SHOULD REACH MN ARROWHEAD...WRN IA...SERN NEB AND NWRN KS BY 12Z. MEANWHILE...QUASISTATIONARY FRONTAL ZONE THAT DENOTES NRN RIM OF EXTREMELY HOT BOUNDARY-LAYER AIR MASS SHOULD LINGER FROM OK PANHANDLE ENEWD OVER SRN KS AND EWD OVER SRN MO.

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST TO CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: NEARLY CONTINUOUS BAND OF TSTMS HAS DEVELOPED FROM NWRN MN SSWWD ACROSS ERN SD TO PORTIONS NEB SANDHILLS...CLOSE TO SFC COLD FRONT. INCREASINGLY QUASI-LINEAR STRUCTURE IS EVIDENT WITH MEAN-WIND/DEEP-SHEAR VECTORS CONTAINING SUBSTANTIAL ORTHOGONAL COMPONENT TO CONVECTIVE ALIGNMENT OVER MN/DAKOTAS SEGMENT. EMBEDDED BOW/LEWP FORMATIONS THEREFORE ARE LIKELY AND MAIN THREAT IS BECOMING DAMAGING GUSTS. HOWEVER...SVR HAIL STILL MAY OCCUR WITH ANY EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS. MAXIMIZED CAPE/SHEAR COMBINATION IS READILY APPARENT OVER CENTRAL/SRN MN...WHERE SFC DEW POINTS MID-60S TO LOW-70S F CONTRIBUTE TO MLCAPE 2000-3000 J/KG AMIDST 45-50 KT WLY EFFECTIVE SHEAR. BUOYANCY AND SHEAR RELATED PARAMETER VALUES EACH DIMINISH WITH NWD AND SSWWD EXTENT FROM THAT AREA...HOWEVER STILL FAVOR OCNL SVR IN NRN MN. FARTHER SW TOWARD CENTRAL NEB...DEEPER/WELL-MIXED SUBCLOUD LAYERS WILL SUPPORT CONTINUING SVR-GUST POTENTIAL. THAT ACTIVITY MAY BACKBUILD ALONG FRONT INTO SWRN NEB...GIVEN PRESENCE OF FAVORABLE MOIST ADVECTION IN ADJACENT WARM SECTOR. REF REMAINDER WW 553...NEWER WWS 554-555...AND RELATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR LATEST NEAR-TERM GUIDANCE ON THIS SITUATION.

sections.title: SERN CONUS
sections.text: WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS CONTINUE ALONG BROAD SWATH OF CENTRAL/SRN APPALACHIANS AND PIEDMONT...IN CORRIDOR OF RICH LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE AND 1000-2000 J/KG MLCAPE AND WEAK DEEP-TROPOSPHERIC WINDS. ISOLATED DAMAGING GUSTS STILL ARE POSSIBLE...THOUGH THREAT SHOULD GRADUALLY DIMINISH THROUGH REMAINDER EVENING WITH NOCTURNAL AND OUTFLOW-RELATED STABILIZATION. ..EDWARDS.. 08/04/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE ACROSS CENTRAL MS INTO CENTRAL AL THIS AFTERNOON WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR A SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. WW ISSUANCE IS BEING CONSIDERED FOR THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWED AN INCREASE CU DEVELOPMENT FROM NORTH CENTRAL MS /JUST S OF THE CLOUD SHIELD/ SEWD INTO WEST CENTRAL AND SRN AL...AND SERN MS. THIS CORRIDOR OF DEEP CU FORMATION WITH A FEW TSTMS ALREADY DEVELOPING PER REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY AND LIGHTNING DATA. THIS ACTIVITY IS LOCATED ALONG A SUBTLE SURFACE TROUGH WITH FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO A SSEWD MOVING MCV OVER NWRN AL AND LOWER TROPOSPHERIC WEAK WAA S OF THIS FEATURE WILL SUPPORT ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON. MODIFIED 12Z JAN RAOB SUGGESTED SURFACE TEMPERATURES RISING INTO THE UPPER 80S WOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO WEAKEN INHIBITION...AND THESE TRENDS ARE NOW BEING OBSERVED PER TSTM DEVELOPMENT AND TRENDS IN OBJECTIVE ANALYSES. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 25-30 KT SAMPLED BY THE VWP/S AT NQA AND GWX SUGGEST MULTICELLS WILL THE DOMINANT STORM MODE WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SFC-BASED TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP AHEAD OF A EWD/SEWD PROGRESSING COLD FRONT ACROSS PORTIONS ERN ND AND N-CNTRL/CNTRL SD. SEVERE WIND AND HAIL AS WELL AS ISOLATED TORNADOES APPEAR POSSIBLE WITH THIS ACTIVITY. A WW WILL LIKELY BE REQUIRED FOR A PORTION OF THE AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS DEPICTS A COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWWD FROM SRN MB ACROSS CNTRL ND AND INTO NWRN SD. A SFC LOW IS LOCATED ALONG THIS FRONT APPROXIMATELY 45 MI W OF MBG. THIS LOW APPEARS TO BE A PSEUDO TRIPLE POINT WITH THE COLD FRONT CONTINUING WSWWD FROM THIS LOW...A WARM FRONT EXTENDING SEWD ACROSS CNTRL/SERN SD...AND A WEAK TROUGH AXIS SSWWD THROUGH S-CNTRL SD INTO THE NEB PANHANDLE. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY IS BEGINNING TO SHOW A CU FIELD ACROSS CNTRL SD...IN AN AREA WHERE TEMPS HAVE REACHED THE UPPER 80S AND MESOANALYSIS INDICATES LITTLE TO NO CINH. ELSEWHERE..SOME CINH STILL REMAINS /AS INDICATED ON THE 18Z ABR SOUNDING/ BUT CONTINUED BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING AND LARGE-SCALE LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH THE COLD FRONT/SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL AID IN FURTHER DESTABILIZATION. CINH SHOULD BE ELIMINATED ACROSS MOST OF THE DISCUSSION AREA DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. MLCAPE A0A 1500 J/KG AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AOA 30 KTS WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED TSTM STRUCTURE WITH AN INITIAL SUPERCELL MODE TRANSITIONING INTO MORE OF A LINEAR MODE. INCREASED SWLY WINDS ALOFT AND AN ASSOCIATED INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL SHEAR ACROSS FAR ERN SD MAY SUPPORT AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT WITH ANY DISCRETE CELLS THAT DEVELOP ACROSS THE AREA. HOWEVER...THIS AREA WILL LIKELY TAKE LONGER TO DESTABILIZE AND MOST OF THE ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO BE IN A LINEAR MODE BY THE TIME IT/S THAT FAR EAST. AS A RESULT...A WW WILL LIKELY BE REQUIRED FOR A PORTION OF THE AREA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD REMAIN CONFINED TO THE AL PORTION OF WW 552 INTO FAR ERN MS. FARTHER WEST INTO CENTRAL MS...THE LACK OF LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE APPEARS TO LIMITING DEEP MOIST CONVECTIVE FORMATION THUS FAR. ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE IN CENTRAL AL...THOUGH THIS WW MAY BE CANCELLED EARLY DUE TO THE LACK OF GREATER STORM ORGANIZATION POTENTIAL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE ENVIRONMENT ACROSS MUCH OF THE AL PORTION OF WW 552 HAS BEEN CONVECTIVELY OVERTURNED REDUCING THE CONTINUED THREAT FOR SEVERE STORMS. THE EXCEPTION RESIDES ALONG THE SRN BOUNDARY OF THIS WATCH IN SWRN AL WHERE STEEPER LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES COULD ENHANCE LOCALIZED DOWNDRAFTS FOR STRONGER WIND GUSTS. 20-30 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AND MLCAPE OF 2500 J/KG SUGGEST MULTICELL STORM DEVELOPMENT REMAINS POSSIBLE. HOWEVER...THIS OVERALL SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IS SOMEWHAT LIMITED BY WEAK MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WHICH WILL TEND TO LIMIT THE DEVELOPMENT OF ROBUST...SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS. ..PETERS.. 08/03/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS OVER ERN ND/SD WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A SVR THREAT INTO THE EVENING...WITH UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A MORE SOLID LINE POSSIBLE AS ACTIVITY ENTERS WRN MN AND NWRN IA. A NEW WW MAY BE NEEDED E OF WW 553 DURING THE NEXT FEW HRS. FARTHER S OVER N-CNTRL/NERN NEB...THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ACCOMPANIED BY AN ISOLATED SVR WEATHER THREAT WILL BE POSSIBLE ALONG A COLD FRONT DURING THE EVENING/NIGHT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 23Z...THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS WERE ONGOING ALONG A SURFACE COLD FRONT FROM NERN SD INTO ERN ND AND FAR NWRN MN. INSTABILITY AXIS EXTENDED NWD ALONG THE MN/DAKOTAS BORDER...WITH RESERVOIR OF HIGHEST MLCAPE VALUES IN EXCESS OF 2000 J/KG LOCATED OVER ERN SD...SWRN MN AND NWRN IA. COMBINATION OF STRONG CONVERGENCE/ASCENT ALONG THE COLD FRONT...FAVORABLE LAPSE RATES/INSTABILITY...AND 0-6 KM BULK SHEAR AOA 40 KT MAY FAVOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A SVR SQUALL LINE AS THE EVENING PROGRESSES. GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF LARGER CAPE VALUES AND A WIDER WARM SECTOR OVER ERN SD INTO SWRN MN/NWRN IA...THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE MOST FAVORED IN THIS AREA DURING THE NIGHT. THUS...AREAS E OF WW 553 WILL BE MONITORED FOR A NEW WW DURING THE NEXT FEW HRS. FARTHER S OVER N-CNTRL/NERN NEB...SURFACE OBSERVATIONS AND AREA PROFILERS/VWP/S INDICATE STRONG DEEP-LAYER CONVERGENCE ALONG COLD FRONTAL SEGMENT ADVANCING SEWD INTO THE AREA. THIS WILL FAVOR ISOLATED/SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT DURING THE EVENING...WITH A FEW STORMS POSING A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS/LARGE HAIL GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF A DRY SUB-CLOUD LAYER AND STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE INCLUSION IN FUTURE WW. ..GARNER.. 08/03/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WELL-ORGANIZED LINE OF STORMS CONTINUES MOVING EWD ACROSS CENTRAL AND ERN MN...THOUGH SOME WEAKENING HAS BEEN NOTED OVER THE PAST HOUR. STILL...WW IS BEING CONSIDERED FOR PORTIONS OF WI AND SERN MN E OF WW 555.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WHILE SOME DECREASE IN OVERALL INTENSITY HAS BEEN NOTED OVER THE PAST HOUR...A FAIRLY WELL-ORGANIZED LINE OF ROBUST STORMS CONTINUES MOVING EWD ACROSS MN. LATEST HRRR RUN SHOWS A SLOW DECREASE IN THE CONVECTIVE LINE WITH TIME -- CONFIRMING LATEST OBSERVED TRENDS...BUT ATTM STORMS REMAIN CAPABLE OF SOME WIND DAMAGE -- AS SEVERAL GUSTS TO NEAR SEVERE LEVELS HAVE OCCURRED RECENTLY PER AREA ASOS OBS. WITH SOME INSTABILITY EXTENDING E OF THE WATCH -- PARTICULARLY ACROSS SERN MN AND INTO W CENTRAL WI...LIMITED THREAT FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING GUSTS APPEARS TO EXIST...POSSIBLY REQUIRING NEW WW. ..GOSS.. 08/04/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED THREAT FOR HAIL AND/OR A DAMAGING WIND GUST CONTINUES ACROSS PARTS OF WW 554.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR LOOP CONTINUES TO SHOW A CLUSTER OF SLIGHTLY ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS ONGOING ACROSS CENTRAL AND NERN NEB...WITH OTHER/MORE SUBSTANTIALLY ELEVATED CONVECTION DEVELOPING FARTHER N INVOF THE NEB/SD BORDER. THE STORMS ARE OCCURRING TO THE COOL SIDE OF A FRONT/OUTFLOW COMBINATION MOVING SSEWD ACROSS NEB...THOUGH ONE STORM -- NOW OVER FAR SWRN CUSTER CO -- APPEARS TO BE A MORE NEARLY SURFACE-BASED STORM IMMEDIATELY N OF THE SURFACE BOUNDARY. ALONG WITH A THREAT FOR A DAMAGING GUST WITH THIS CELL...POTENTIAL FOR MARGINAL HAIL CONTINUES WITH A FEW OF THE STRONGER/MORE-ELEVATED CELLS. ..GOSS.. 08/04/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LEADING SQUALL LINE WILL BEGIN MOVING EAST OF WW 556 BY 07Z. ISOLATED STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO...BUT OVERALL THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BECOME INCREASINGLY MARGINAL. ANOTHER WW EAST OF 556 IS NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SQUALL LINE OVER WRN WI CONTINUES EAST AT 35-40 KT AND IS APPROACHING THE ERN EDGE OF WW 556. THREAT FOR ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL PERSIST NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...MAINLY ALONG LEADING GUST FRONT THROUGH WRN AND EVENTUALLY CNTRL WI. HOWEVER...THE STORMS ARE MOVING INTO AN INCREASINGLY MARGINAL THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT AND SHIFTING EAST OF PRIMARY LLJ AXIS WHICH SHOULD PROMOTE A GRADUAL WEAKENING TREND. OTHER STORMS ARE DEVELOPING FARTHER WEST ACROSS NRN IA INTO SRN MN WHERE SLY LLJ IS CONTRIBUTING TO ISENTROPIC ASCENT NORTH OF THE TRAILING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUSTS CANNOT BE RULED OUT AND SMALL TO MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL MAY ALSO BE POSSIBLE. THIS ACTIVITY IS MOVING ABOVE A MORE STABLE BOUNDARY LAYER WHICH SHOULD MITIGATE THE DAMAGING WIND THREAT. ..DIAL.. 08/04/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS DEVELOPING OVER CNTRL MO AND EVENTUALLY INTO SWRN IL MAY PRODUCE ISOLATED SMALL TO MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING. AT THIS TIME OVERALL THREAT DOES NOT APPEAR SUFFICIENT TO WARRANT A WW...BUT AREA WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDS FROM SRN IL THROUGH CNTRL MO AND SERN KS. ISENTROPIC ASCENT RESULTING FROM STRENGTHENING SWLY LLJ HAS PROMOTED THE DEVELOPMENT OF STORMS NORTH OF THIS BOUNDARY WITHIN A WEAK SHEAR ENVIRONMENT. RESERVOIR OF MODERATE INSTABILITY EXISTS ACROSS ECNTRL MO INTO SRN IL WITH 1000-1500 CAPE FOR PARCELS LIFTED FROM AROUND 800 MB. THIS IN CONJUNCTION WITH 7 C/KM 850-500 MB LAPSE RATES MAY SUPPORT A THREAT OF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WITH ELEVATED MULTICELL STORMS THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING.
